notes_for_editor: No build date, staffing, owner history or present condition in any readable source. The anyplaceamerica.com topo listing for the tower returned HTTP 403 and was not read. The 112 ft figure is the NGS 'overall height' and may not equal height to the cab floor; height_m 34.1 records the overall figure. The brief's coordinates are within about 100 m of the NGS datasheet position (33 29 10 N, 093 12 34 W), so no correction is proposed. The NHLR and FFLOS caches do not list this tower.
